title: Studio opens your 3MFs, in colour and ready to print
summary: Thingport 1.8.0 opens any 3MF in Studio with its plates and colours, and a design now carries its own print settings into your slicer. Most of the rest is what you asked for: a shared print queue and filament shelf, notes on your models, a 3D printing wiki, Send to your printer, the thumbnail you pick, sorting by name, and Thingport in German.

items.title: Studio: open a 3MF, colour it, set how it prints
items.description: Open any 3MF from your library in Studio and it comes in whole: every plate, every part where the designer put it, in its colours. Colour parts, move them between plates and arrange each plate on your printer's bed. Then give the design a print profile in the new Print tab: start from a preset such as Strong, Outdoor or Vase, and change what you like. It travels in every 3MF Studio makes, opens straight in your slicer with your printer picked, and shows on the model's page once you save the design to your library.

images.caption: A 3MF opened in Studio: its parts in their colours, its plates under Objects / Plates
The Print tab: the Toy preset for Bambu Studio and a P1S, every setting a click away
Save to Thingport as a new model, or as one more print profile of a model you have

items.title: Print together: a shared queue and a filament shelf
items.description: Two new tools for a household that prints together. Print queue: add a model from its page, or a whole selection at once, and everyone sees who has what queued, printing or printed on one shared board. Filament shelf: everyone's spools on one shelf, and on each model's page the filaments it needs and who has them. An admin installs them on the Administration → Tools page.

images.caption: Print queue: the household's prints on one board
Filament shelf: everyone's spools, and the filaments a model needs

items.title: Notes on your models
items.description: Pin a note to any model's picture, as a speech bubble or a sticky note, just for you or for everyone. The Notes window keeps them all together, to search by model or by what they say.

images.caption: Sticky notes and bubbles on a model's picture

items.title: The 3D Printing Wiki, with a quiz
items.description: Print came out wrong? The new 3D Printing Wiki tool walks you through 46 problems to a fix, explains the slicer settings that matter, and names each one as Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer and Cura call it. Then try its quiz: pass the exam to earn the FDM Fundamentals badge.

images.caption: Searching the 3D Printing Wiki for stringing

items.title: Send it to your printer
items.description: Send a model's file from its page straight to OctoPrint, Klipper or PrusaLink, to a Home Assistant, n8n or Node-RED webhook, or to an address of your own. Set your places up in the Configuration dialog under Send to: each person has their own.

images.caption: Send to places in the Configuration dialog: printers and webhooks

items.title: Instructions and parts lists, open on the model page
items.description: A model's supporting files get a tab of their own on its page, and open right there: PDFs, pictures, READMEs, scripts and parts lists. It's the first half of a bigger feature: adding them to your own models, and bringing every one in with your imports, comes in the next release.

images.caption: A model's README, open on its page beside its other files

items.title: Deutsch, and tools in your language
items.description: Thingport and the Thingport Grab extension now speak German, and every tool in the repository but the new wiki speaks all nine of Thingport's languages.

items.title: Pick a model's thumbnail
items.description: Choose the picture a model's card shows: click Use as thumbnail on it in the Edit model dialog.

images.caption: Use as thumbnail in the Edit model dialog

items.title: Sort by name, and flip any sort
items.description: Every list of models sorts by name now, Cable 2 before Cable 10. Click the chosen sort again to flip it: Newest becomes Oldest.

items.title: A quicker model menu
items.description: On the model page, the ⋯ menu opens with big tiles for Download, Open in your slicer, Add to collection and Edit. On cards, the rest waits in submenus.

images.caption: The model page's ⋯ menu, with tiles for what you do most

items.title: Parts that fit back together
items.description: Split a part in Studio with pins and sockets, print a quick fit test, and apply the clearance that fits your printer.

items.title: Tools right where you need them
items.description: Tools can add their actions to a model's menu and to a grid's selection, and their own parts to the model page. The Print cost estimator's Estimate print cost is one click from a file. An admin can now switch a tool off without uninstalling it, and update every tool at once.

items.title: More for tool makers
items.description: The tools SDK adds data a household shares, commands, parts of the model page and Thingport's own model picker.

items.title: Thingport Bridge says what went wrong
items.description: When a model doesn't open, the Thingport Bridge desktop helper now tells you why and offers Try again. On macOS, it takes you to the Local Network setting that was blocking it.

items.title: Behind a reverse proxy? A new guide says what it has to let through, and Thingport and the Thingport Grab extension now say when the proxy, not Thingport, turned a request down
Studio keeps the Ask AI conversation beside the design while you look, and its design menu lists your recent designs
Download all counts every file a model has, and its ZIP holds the prepared print too
The Administration → Storage page shows supporting files and prepared prints apart
Errors on the models, search, tag and collection pages show as Thingport's own messages, not the browser's pop-ups
3MFs from Windows' 3D Builder, and others that name their model differently, get 3D previews, card pictures and print checks
Downloads keep their names, accents and spaces included, and a ZIP unzips whole on a Mac or Windows
A disk that doesn't answer no longer makes a model's files look missing, and a repair keeps the files it didn't lose
Deleting a model removes all of it, never half
A zip's __MACOSX folder and other leftovers no longer turn into broken models
Zip, F3D and picture files download instead of offering a slicer that can't open them
Moving quickly from one model to the next never shows the first one's details
Adding a picture to a model that had only its 3D render saves again
Signing in behind an HTTPS reverse proxy keeps your session cookie secure
Four messages about AI assistants, connected instances and chats now say what's true
The Thingport Grab extension's missing translations are filled in
